arena: [생존기] With Survival Tactics, Feign Death reduces damage taken by 90% for 2 sec. Press Feign Death when the enemy pops burst cooldowns and unloads on you.
[생존기] Aspect of the Turtle makes all spells and attacks miss you and reduces damage taken by 30% for 8 sec, but you can't attack meanwhile. Use it when no other defensive can keep you alive.
[생존기] Survival of the Fittest reduces all damage taken by 30% for 6 sec. Use it first, before you get stunned or when the burst starts.
[회피] Scatter Shot incapacitates a target within 20 yds for 3 sec and removes all DoTs. Peel melee DPS off you, then gain distance with Disengage to make room for Aimed Shot casts.
[제어] Intimidation stuns a target up to 40 yds away for 5 sec. Pop Trueshot and burst while the enemy healer is locked down.
[제어] Chimaeral Sting slows the target by 90% for 3 sec, then silences for 3 sec, then reduces damage and healing by 20% for 3 sec. Put it on the enemy healer during your burst to delay their heals.
[차단] Counter Shot interrupts a cast from 40 yds and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Freezing Trap incapacitates the first enemy to approach for 1 min but damage can break it. While the enemy healer is trapped, your team bursts another target.
bg: [참고] When you're on base defense, place Freezing Trap in front of the base flag you're guarding to incapacitate the first enemy that comes to capture.

[제어] Chimaeral Sting was picked by 37 of 44 Battleground Blitz players and applies a 3 sec 90% slow followed by a 3 sec silence. Use it to hold the enemy flag carrier or shut down the enemy healer trying to save their carrier.
[위치] With Sniper's Advantage, all shot ranges increase by 30% during Trueshot and Volley. In base teamfights, burst from a distance enemy melee DPS can't reach.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Survival of the Fittest or Aspect of the Turtle right before the burst.
[위치] Aspect of the Cheetah increases movement speed by 90% for 3 sec, then 30% for 9 sec. Use it to quickly support a distant base under attack or your flag carrier.
[해제] Tranquilizing Shot removes one Enrage effect and one magic effect from an enemy target. Strip magic buffs from the enemy flag carrier or base defenders.
pvpTalents: Survival Tactics, picked by all top 43 Solo Shuffle players and 38 of 44 Battleground Blitz players, adds a 90% damage reduction for 2 sec to Feign Death. Scatter Shot, picked by 40 of 43 Solo Shuffle players, gives a 3 sec incapacitate and removes DoTs. Chimaeral Sting, picked by 34 of 43 Solo Shuffle and 37 of 44 Battleground Blitz players, applies a slow, a silence, then a damage and healing reduction in sequence.

213691.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
213691.d: (전투력의 4.4616%)의 피해를 입히고, 모든 해로운 지속 피해 효과를 제거합니다. 또한 3초 동안 적을 행동 불가 상태로 만들며, 대상에 대한 공격을 중단합니다. 사정거리가 짧습니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다. [억제의 족쇄: 분산 사격으로 행동 불가 상태가 된 대상의 효과가 사라지면 8초 동안 대상에게 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다]

356719.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
356719.d:
독침으로 대상을 찔러 (전투력의 150%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 일련의 맹독을 주입합니다. 각각의 맹독은 3초 동안 지속되며, 이전 맹독 효과 하나가 종료되면 다음 효과를 부여합니다.

전갈 맹독:
이동 속도를 90%만큼 감소시킵니다.

거미 맹독:
침묵시킵니다.

살무사 맹독:
공격력과 치유량을 20%만큼 감소시킵니다.

1217102.d: 정조준과 연발 사격이 지속시간 동안 모든 사격 능력의 사정거리를 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.
